# pushward_org_member (Resource)

A member of the organization, invited by email.

Creating one mails a one-use invite; the member is `pending` until the person joins with it, then `joined` with a `user_id`. Terraform notices on the next plan. An invite that expires, is revoked or is used up before anyone joins, and a member who leaves or is removed, drop out of the state, so the next apply invites them again.

While pending, changing `email` or `role` revokes the invite and mails a new one. Once joined, `role` changes the member's role and `email` the address PushWard shows for them, an unverified label.

An org admin key grants `member` and `viewer` only. Owners, admins and billing members are managed in the PushWard console; reading or importing one is an error.

Revoking the org admin key, or lowering it from `manage` to `read`, revokes the open invites it sent. The key also stops working when the person who created it leaves the organization, is removed, loses admin rights or deletes their account, and its invites go the same way. A `read` key cannot read invites and a revoked one is refused, so plans with those members fail until a working `manage` key is configured. Then they drop out of the state and the next apply mails each of them a new invite. Make the key from an owner account, and to rotate it, roll it in the console, which keeps its invites, instead of replacing it with a new key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
locals {
  team = {
    "ann@example.com"   = "member"
    "piotr@example.com" = "member"
    "audit@example.com" = "viewer"
  }
}

# Each address gets an invite by email. Until the person joins, status is
# "pending" and user_id is null.
resource "pushward_org_member" "team" {
  for_each = local.team
  email    = each.key
  role     = each.value
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Where the invite is mailed, and the member's label once they join. Lowercase and without surrounding whitespace, as PushWard stores it; `lower(trimspace())` helps.
- `role` (String) `member` or `viewer`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The user id once joined, the invite id while pending.
- `invite_id` (String) The invite that was mailed; null after an import.
- `org_id` (String) The organization the resource belongs to, that of the provider's org admin key when the resource was created or imported. An org admin key of another organization is an error, not a plan that creates the resource again there.
- `status` (String) `pending` until the person joins, then `joined`.
- `user_id` (String) The member's user id; null until they join.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A member who already joined, by user id (pushward_org_members lists them).
terraform import 'pushward_org_member.team["ann@example.com"]' 3f1c7a52-8d0e-4b6a-9c3f-2a7d5e8b1c04
```
